glosses: jury (a group of individuals chosen to hear and decide a case in a court of law)
jury (the audience attending the first night of a performance)

examples.en: The jury acquitted him of the crime.

examples.text: Por que não explicamos ao júri?
examples.en: Why don't we explain it to the jury?

examples.text: O advogado apelou ao sentido da justiça do júri.
examples.en: The lawyer appealed to the jury's sense of justice.
